chapter: Leading the band after Chick Webb, 1939-40
title: Tommy Fulford, Ram Ramirez and Lonnie Simmons
summary: Fulford fell ill and died; Ramirez filled in; McRae hired Lonnie Simmons, who later led a combo in Chicago.

blocks.x: A couple of new people who were in the band -- some of them temporarily. Like Ram Ramirez comes in the band shortly and replaces Tommy Fulford Welpert for a while.

Who replaced him? Bill Furness? No, these (inaudible). What about this other saxophone player who played tenor who was added -- Sam Simmons?

Lonnie Simmons. I added Lonnie Simmons to the band when we went to the Roseland. Remember when I took over the band? Lonnie was out in Chicago. Lonnie played organ and tenor, but we never used him on organ. He used to play tenor. Because eventually, he went back to Chicago, and he had his combo around Chicago. It was very famous.
